title: Total distance correct
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the total path length as 14 m.

title: Displacement magnitude correct
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the magnitude of the displacement from O to B as 10 m.

title: Average velocity magnitude correct
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the magnitude of the average velocity as 2 m/s.

title: Uses displacement for velocity
description: Important: The student must use the magnitude of the displacement, not the total distance, in the average velocity formula.

title: Applies Pythagorean theorem
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the Pythagorean theorem to find the resultant displacement from the north and west components.

title: Correct units included
description: Optional: The student includes correct units (m and m/s) with their final numerical answers.

title: Confuses distance and displacement
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses the total distance (14 m) instead of the displacement (10 m) to calculate average velocity.

title: Arithmetic or sign error
description: Pitfall: The student makes a simple arithmetic error in the Pythagorean calculation or in the division for average velocity.
